subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should #38364 remain open as the umbrella for Control UI structured reply metadata plus no-output UX, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Main has partial fixes and several related issues/PRs, but no single merged item fully owns both halves of this request.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave #38364 open until both structured reply metadata and no-output completion semantics are landed or intentionally rejected.

options.title: Split To Canonicals
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after maintainers confirm #90745/#88032 own reply metadata and #87561/#85714/#97324 own no-output delivery semantics.

options.title: Accept Quote-Only UI
options.body: Treat the merged Markdown-quote Dashboard reply as sufficient and drop the structured metadata ask for Control UI.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave #38364 open until both structured reply metadata and no-output completion semantics are landed or intentionally rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses Control UI, agent runtime context, and final-delivery policy, where the history points to steipete as the best available broad decision owner.
